intended_application: Draft replies to routine customer-support messages from an approved knowledge base; a human agent reviews and sends each reply
organization: Harbor Support Services, a fictional contact-center outsourcer
business_need: Improve response quality and handling time without removing human approval
users_stakeholders: Support agents, clients, end customers, quality reviewers
capabilities_constraints: Current agents search a knowledge base and draft replies manually. In this constructed scenario, most client contracts bill by agent hour; no pilot, repricing, or productivity outcome has been observed.
risk_consequence_context: Incorrect answers could harm clients; human approval and escalation are required
management_question: Classify the proposed use and its possible significance over the next 12 months
additional_context: Constructed teaching case. The LLM is an existing external service, not a model invented by Harbor. The stated contract mix is a scenario assumption, not a verified real-company fact.
